description: Section 7.3: Outlook's single quotes around a name, a name that only repeats the address, white space in names, the From name preferred over To and Cc names, names most recent first, the domain folded and the local part kept, an undated message read first, and a contact never seen in a dated message sorted last.

messages.raw:
From: 'Anna Becker' <anna@Example.NET>
To: Alice Example <alice@example.com>, Zed <zed@example.net>
Subject: Hello
Message-ID: <c1@example.net>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Undated.

From: "anna@example.net" <anna@example.net>
To: Alice Example <alice@example.com>
Cc: Ann B. <anna@example.net>
Subject: Again
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:00:00 GMT
Message-ID: <c2@example.net>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The From name is the address.

From: Bob Svoboda <bob@example.org>
To: "Anna   Becker-Novak" <anna@example.net>
Cc: alice <alice@example.com>
Subject: Names
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 10:00:00 GMT
Message-ID: <c3@example.org>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

White space in a To name.

From: Alice E. <alice@example.com>
To: Bob@example.org
Subject: Case
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 11:00:00 GMT
Message-ID: <c4@example.com>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The local part's case is kept.
